crossRefs.note: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

people.name: Hazeroth
people.line: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings

people.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
people.line: A place where the Israelites complained and were punished

translations.web: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
translations.bsb: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
translations.kjv: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.
